mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hub (id, hub_code, name, min_transfer_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{hubCode}, #{name}, #{minTransferMinutes}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, hub_code, name, min_transfer_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at FROM hub ORDER BY hub_code ASC
SELECT id, hub_code, name, min_transfer_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at FROM hub WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY hub_code ASC
